bookings.eventName: National Technical Workshop on Artificial Intelligence
bookings.description:
The event will begin with the registration of participants, followed by the welcome address and inauguration. The Chief Guest and invited dignitaries will be welcomed and felicitated with mementos. A technical session on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning will be conducted by the invited speaker, followed by an interactive question-and-answer session. The programme will conclude with a vote of thanks and a group photograph.

12:00 PM – 12:30 PM: Interactive Q&A Session
